points: Each participant chooses a final hand amount in 0–2 independently.
Adjustment can draw or discard; two empty hands may each draw two.
If the two resulting hand counts are equal there is no Duel; otherwise the fewer-hand participant uses Duel on the other.

engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.simultaneousChoices: The exact text requires simultaneous adjustment. The engine collects each participant's count and retained entities privately on the owning frame, including AI choices. Every participant submits exactly three answers: one count plus two retained slots, with empty private confirmations for unused slots. Frozen SlotIndex and constant command cardinality prevent public revision increments from disclosing the first commitment's size. Neither committed count, retained faces nor any hand movement becomes public before both are committed.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.simultaneousPayment: After both commitments, original discards for both and actual draws for both are paid before opening any movement, health or skill-change observer. Original hand residency and every movement interval are frozen. Existing native batch boundaries are preserved; no artificial early child is inserted between the two payments.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.nativeDiscardRestrictions: The native prohibition against discarding a protected hand entity remains authoritative. Such entities are frozen into the retained set and an impossible requested lower count is reduced only as far as those native restrictions permit; this exceptional interaction is an engine mapping, not an official Hao Pu FAQ.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.comparison: After the simultaneous adjustment's genuine observers return, current actual hand counts are compared. Any observer-created change is included. Initial actor/target and both comparison counts are frozen at Duel issuance; source loss cannot repeat payment or redirect that issued use. No formal FAQ specifying this observer ordering was located.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.nativeDuel: The smaller hand uses one real cardless Duel through commitment, nullification, alternating Slash response, native damage and dying. Equal counts, a dead participant or native use/target prohibition yield no Duel. The selected actor may be Hao Pu or the other participant.
engineMappingsExplicitlyNotOfficialFAQ.sourceLoss: Already paid adjustment children and the issued Duel retain their exact owning frame, source instance, actual turn and Play phase after source loss. An actual participant death is resolved by the native child before deciding whether a Duel remains possible.
